title: SetErrorType enum missing #[non_exhaustive] — adding a variant is a breaking change
description: backend.rs:100-150 — SetErrorType is a public enum with 22 variants. It is #[derive(Debug,Clone,PartialEq,Serialize,Deserialize)] but lacks #[non_exhaustive]. RFC 8621 and future JMAP extensions may introduce new error types. Without #[non_exhaustive], match arms in downstream crates that handle SetErrorType will fail to compile when a new variant is added. Add the attribute to maintain semver compatibility.
